protocol.purpose: Supplemental tool-only transfer check, not six-world score nor hidden-test prediction. Random parameters and structures not identical to development laws.
protocol.selection: Evaluate returned rank 1 only, no oracle selection. All four outcomes retained; no retuning this frozen version from these results.
